doc: Which practices open the breath engine (engine/breath, "Practise with the body") and how. mode body = the body of light with one locus lit; mode text = text and the timer only (orientation-only, reading, movement, lying, daily-life, initiated or course-taught practices). Breath: natural only; pace {inn,out} seconds (default 4.2/6.0, ~5.9/min), lead = gently lengthen (exhale first, never past ~5.5/min); retention is never part of any practice here (the engine cannot hold). Loci: engine/breath/body.js LOCUS. Checked by app/tools/test-practice-body.mjs; merged into practices[].body by tools/build-collections.py.

loci.heart: a warm point at the heart that radiates on the out-breath
loci.nostrils: a fine stream at the nostrils, in and out with the breath
loci.belly: a soft light in the lower belly (hara) that rises and falls
loci.central: the central channel (sushumna) and its loci brighter
loci.channels: the three channels: central, ida (teal) and pingala (rose)
loci.space: the light widened into the space around the body

active-imagination-imaginal-attention.why: Stay with an image as a presence; the breath is only the ground.

analytic-meditation-on-the-stages-of-the.why: Discursive Lamrim contemplation on a calm breath; no locus in the source.

anapanasati-breath-meditation-method-2.why: Ajahn Lee: notice the breath where it is clearest (classically the nose tip) and let it become comfortable; gentle lead allowed.

basic-saiva-siddhanta-meditation.why: "Regulate the breath to a slow even count, then draw awareness inward to the spine": an even, unled count and the spinal channel.

body-sweeping-goenka-vipassana.why: Goenka vipassanā is taught on a 10-day course after days of ānāpāna; the tradition asks that it be learned there.

buddho-recollection.why: "Bud-" on the in-breath, "-dho" on the out-breath at the breath's touch point (Ajahn Mun line).

calming-and-contemplation-zhiguan.why: Zhiyi's calming (zhi) settles the breath and attention below the navel; then contemplation.

centering-prayer.why: Consent to presence with a sacred word; no breath technique or locus in the source.

christian-meditation-with-a-mantra-maran.why: WCCM: four equal syllables, listened to; no locus or breath technique in the source.

contemplating-not-self.why: Each aggregate in turn: the whole body-and-mind field is the object.

drawing-the-sri-chakra-as-meditation.why: A drawing practice following a teacher's construction.

dream-yoga-first-steps.why: A daytime habit and a night practice, not a timed sit.

ease-through-the-body-trika-prep.why: Trika prep: rest where the breath is clearest, then let ease spread through the whole body (source wording, so whole rather than the central channel).

feeding-your-demons-a-modern-adaptation-.why: Find where the struggle lives in the body, then feed it: the whole body is the field.

five-points-of-yoga-sivananda.why: A way of life, not a sit.

goodwill-metta.why: Goodwill is felt and widened from the heart.

hare-krishna-mahamantra-japa-and-kirtan.why: Chanted aloud and in kīrtan: a continuous vocal practice that a breath pacer would fight.

huatou.why: Hold the question; no locus is named in the source.

japa-repetition-of-a-divine-name.why: Japa of a divine name on a natural breath.

koan-practice-with-mu.why: Mu breathed on each exhalation from the hara (lower belly); a longer exhale.

looking-at-the-mind-mahamudra.why: Mahāmudrā: look for the looker; open awareness.

mahasi-noting.why: Mahāsi: the rising and falling of the abdomen. Known, not led.

mantra-repetition-japa.why: Japa at an even pace on a natural breath; the mantra itself comes from the tradition.

metta-loving-kindness.why: Mettā widened from the heart in rings.

mindful-breathing-pv.why: "In / Out", then "Deep / Slow": Plum Village often rests the breath in the rise and fall of the abdomen.

mindfulness-of-breathing.why: Ānāpānasati: know each in- and out-breath; the Thai and Burmese teachers start at the touch point at the nostrils. The breath is known, not led.

mindfulness-of-death-maranasati.why: A reflection carried on an easy breath; no locus is named in the source.

natural-awareness-right-attitude.why: Shwe Oo Min: relax and know whatever is experienced; no single object.

neelakantha-meditation.why: An initiated mantra practice, described only so the clips make sense.

nembutsu-nianfo.why: Recitation of the Name on a natural breath.

neoplatonic-contemplation.why: Plotinus: turn from objects to knowing itself, then let that go.

nine-breathings.why: The three channels (Bön nine breathings), on a natural, unforced breath; the alternation is in the words, not forced by the engine.

nyasa.why: Placing syllables on the body is learned with the mantra from a teacher.

open-awareness-shamatha-without-a-suppor.why: Shamatha without a support: open, spacious, eyes open.

owner-of-my-actions.why: A recollection on an easy breath.

practising-dying-melete-thanatou.why: A philosophical exercise; the breath steadies it, no locus in the source.

preparing-for-the-bardo.why: A daily-life practice (the gaps of falling asleep, between thoughts), not a timed sit.

rain.why: Recognise, allow, investigate in the body, then nurture: the nurture step is often a hand on the heart.

recognition-pratyabhijna-contemplation.why: Alternates reading a sūtra with looking at experience: a reading practice.

recollecting-the-round.why: A contemplation; the breath only steadies it.

recollection-of-past-lives-orientation.why: Orientation only: a reading about past-life recollection, not a guided sit.

resting-in-the-gap-between-breaths-vijna.why: VBT breath-pause (vv. 24-27): the turns of the breath along the central channel. Natural breath; the engine never holds, the turn is only noticed.

satipatthana-four-establishings-of-mindf.why: Body, feeling, mind, qualities: the whole field, starting from the body.

self-enquiry.why: Ramana: trace the I to its source, the spiritual heart.

self-enquiry-who-dies.why: Ramana places the source of the I-thought in the heart (hṛdaya); attention rests there.

shamatha-with-object.why: Calm abiding on the breath as the support, at the nostrils. Known, not led.

shikantaza-just-sitting.why: Just sitting: aware of the whole posture, no object.

shiva-process-self-inquiry.why: A spoken, layered enquiry usually done in pairs or with a guide; text keeps it honest.

silent-illumination-mozhao.why: Mozhao: aware of the whole body sitting, then widening.

sravanamanananididhyasana.why: Listening to the Upaniṣads with a teacher: a study practice.

the-five-remembrances.why: A reflection, not a breath technique: the body simply breathes slowly while the lines come one at a time.

the-jesus-prayer-prayer-of-the-heart.why: The prayer of the heart: the hesychast tradition joins the prayer to the breath and rests the mind in the heart.

the-view-from-above-spiritual-exercise.why: Rise above in imagination until concerns take the scale of the cosmos.

tonglen.why: Taking in heaviness, sending out lightness, at the heart.

twelve-kalis.why: A study sequence (the Krama Kālīs), one at a time.

unio-mystica-letters.why: Listed for context, not as instruction.

vbt-body-as-consciousness.why: VBT: the whole body at once as consciousness.

vbt-inner-outer-spaces.why: VBT: the space at the meeting of inner and outer.

vbt-mind-between-objects.why: VBT: rest in the gap between objects; the central channel is the Trika seat of the in-between.

vbt-sound-dissolution.why: VBT vv. 38-41: inner sound followed into quiet, along the central channel.

vbt-space-contemplation.why: VBT: the space that holds the room and the body.

vbt-twelve-centres.why: A daily-life practice, not a sit (source).

walking-meditation.why: A walking practice: the seated body does not fit.

walking-meditation-jongrom.why: A walking practice: the seated body does not fit.

welcoming-practice.why: Feel the reaction as a sensation in the body and welcome it.

what-am-i-don-t-know.why: The question on the in-breath, "Don't know..." as long as the out-breath: a longer exhale, no locus named.

yoga-nidra.why: Practised lying down: the seated body does not fit.

zazen.why: Sōtō zazen: breathe naturally through the nose; the breath settles into the hara.

zikr-remembrance-in-the-inayati-way.why: The remembrance settles in the heart (Inayati).
